visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed rotating homepage hero with one photo, eyebrow, title, description and CTA per slide, plus labelled progress indicators
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-bleed rotating hero, 4 slides, each a full-width photo with left-aligned dark overlay text (signpost eyebrow, H1, description, orange pill CTA). Bottom indicator bar with labeled progress segments (RAIN RFID, MCX A5, SDV, Tech Days); active segment orange. Photo background belongs to the block, so the section is not colored.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1 = background image; cell 2 = optional short indicator label paragraph, eyebrow paragraph, H1/H2 title, description paragraph, CTA link. With two paragraphs before the heading the first becomes the indicator label; otherwise the heading text is used
contentPattern.description: Interactive rotating component with 4 slides; each slide has its own full-bleed photo and text. Photo background belongs to the block.

usage: Top-of-page hero with 2+ rotating promotional slides. A single row renders as a static hero without controls.
reuseGuidance: Use for any rotating full-width hero. For a single static hero prefer the hero block.
